claim: Actual global differential averaging equals the genuine generic-field trace on dt coefficients, with normalized global idempotence
author: /root/restart_hodge_gluing

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.required: The same integral rational contact model, actual fifth completed map and genuine generic-stalk trace.
obligations.constructed: The existing source and target integrality, exact original-field square and pullbackAlgebra are used unchanged. The source is the fixed rational-twist model.
obligations.why_match: No abstract degree-eight field is substituted for the actual generic-stalk map.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.required: An actual whole-open coefficient of every global intrinsic differential.
obligations.constructed: form is the inverse of the established affine section equivalence applied to the actual restriction. coefficient applies the genuine dt frame and original openEmbedding.
obligations.why_match: No rational differential is assumed to extend globally: the input was already a global section.

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.required: Every global source section and exactly the eight field automorphisms fixing the fifth subfield.
obligations.constructed: The Boolean fixing signs are mapped by their literal FourRootAutomorphisms signEquiv into the actual fixing subgroup. Injectivity and both exact cardinalities prove bijectivity.
obligations.why_match: The enumeration is a concrete map; it is not an arbitrary equivalence between two eight-element sets.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.required: Canonical source pullback on Omega must agree with the original field action on its dt coefficient.
obligations.constructed: The actual entire source-sign/open-chart square gives form_action. Since the action fixes t, the genuine semilinear dt-frame theorem gives coefficient_action.
obligations.why_match: Both scalar transport and the exact full chart are retained; neither pointwise agreement nor dense-point heuristics are used.

obligations.name: Identity of the consumed object
obligations.required: Compare the same generic-stalk trace defined for the actual fifth map.
obligations.constructed: genericCoefficient is sourceEquiv.symm of the actual whole-open coefficient. The exact original_trace_sum and actual_field_square give the two trace identities.
obligations.why_match: The pullback direction is explicitly Target.functionField to Model.functionField. This packet does not define a generic Kaehler-module trace.

obligations.name: Coefficient and normalization conventions
obligations.required: Keep the dt coordinate and genuine factors eight and one eighth.
obligations.constructed: Actual structural rational functions commute with restriction and the chart section equivalence; coefficient_smul proves the conversion. The normalized average is compared with the existing normalized trace retraction/projection.
obligations.why_match: There is no unexplained scalar change or replacement of the already normalized fifth invariant pullback.

obligations.name: Local/global conditions
obligations.required: A coefficient equality must detect actual global intrinsic differential sections.
obligations.constructed: coefficient_injective combines the original embedding injection, actual whole-open frame, affine section equivalence and previously proved integral five-chart restriction detection.
obligations.why_match: No global trivialization of Omega or basis theorem is assumed.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases and evidence
obligations.required: Do not lose characteristic, nonempty-chart or denominator hypotheses.
obligations.constructed: All source and target objects remain the fixed characteristic-zero model. The predecessor integral detection carries its nonempty whole-open hypotheses. Rational normalization is exactly inverse eight in the actual fields.
obligations.why_match: The packet introduces no branch-point division, all-base extension or positive-characteristic assertion.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.required: Provide the precise bridge from source-global averaging to the genuine generic-field trace.
obligations.constructed: The normalized generic coefficient is the actual field projection. Its known idempotence, followed by genuine global coefficient detection, proves average_twice for every global differential.
obligations.why_match: This proves an actual global idempotent but does not identify its image with regular target differential pullbacks or construct a target-Omega transfer.

external_input_scope: No new literature input. Existing exact generic trace and actual sheaf/frame functoriality are joined.

A sheaf morphism from source pushforward Omega to target Omega
Identification of the whole projector image with regular target differential pullbacks
A complete global differential basis or dimension
Picard norm, source Jacobian, polarization or PEL/KS/height comparison
